chunks: And ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said to him:
O ʿUbayd, indeed extravagance bequeaths poverty, and indeed moderation bequeaths wealth.

key_terms.السَّرَفَ: extravagance and wasteful excess in spending
key_terms.يُورِثُ: causes, brings about, or leads to as an outcome

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام describe the effect of extravagance and moderation on wealth?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام teaches that wastefulness and excess lead a person toward poverty. By contrast, moderation and balanced spending are a cause of wealth and financial stability.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3659 - Ubayd bin Zurarah narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), that he said to him:
'O Ubayd, extravagance leads to poverty, and moderation leads to wealth.'
